verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is India's government-run online portal for foreigner registration and visa services. Its core function is carried out by the issuing authority itself, so self-hosting it is a category error for this kind of product rather than a missing capability. The evidence pack contains only front-door availability probes and nothing suggesting a self-hostable distribution, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
